query:
SELECT 
  d.id as devedorId, d.name, d.unitNumber,
  c.id as cobrancaId, c.amount, c.dueDate, c.status, c.description, c.tipoCobranca
FROM devedores d
JOIN cobrancas c ON c.devedorId = d.id
WHERE d.condominioId = 210001
LIMIT 10;
